structured.recommendation: Do not commit to a specific rollout policy yet. The issue states a goal (reduce deployment risk, issue:L1) and a constraint (preserve delivery speed, issue:L2) but supplies no operating data to trade them off (issue:L1-L3). Picking a policy now would be guessing. Defer until baseline evidence exists: current deploy frequency, change-failure rate, mean-time-to-recovery, whether automated rollback and health signals exist, and how "delivery speed" is measured. With those, a progressive/canary rollout with automated rollback is the likely balanced candidate — but only measurement can confirm it does not violate the speed constraint (issue:L2).

evidence.claim: Two competing objectives are stated: reduce deployment risk and preserve delivery speed
The question asks which rollout policy balances both, but no system context or metrics are provided to evaluate any policy

assumptions.statement: No baseline metrics (deploy frequency, change-failure rate, MTTR) are given in the issue
assumptions.if_false_then: If such metrics are actually available, a concrete policy could be recommended now instead of deferring
assumptions.how_to_verify: Re-read issue:L1-L3 for any quantitative data (none present)

assumptions.statement: Whether automated rollback and health-check gating exist is unspecified
assumptions.if_false_then: If automated rollback is absent, canary/progressive options are much weaker and risk reduction is limited
assumptions.how_to_verify: Ask issue owner about current deployment tooling and rollback automation

risks: Choosing a policy without failure-rate and MTTR data may optimize the wrong dimension
A heavy staged rollout could silently violate the delivery-speed constraint (issue:L2)
'Balances both' is undefined — no threshold for acceptable risk or acceptable speed loss is given (issue:L3)
what_would_change_my_view: Concrete baseline metrics (deploy frequency, change-failure rate, MTTR) being supplied
Confirmation that automated rollback and health-signal gating already exist
An explicit, measurable definition of the acceptable risk/speed trade-off threshold
structured.next_action: Request the four baseline figures — deploy frequency, change-failure rate, MTTR, and current rollback automation — before any rollout policy is selected.
